additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
We need to plan for site visit.
We can see Power Converter 14, We need to identify it and replace with adjacent one and check if CanCommLoss is cable specific issue or converter specific.
We need to tighten the communication line.
We don't see any other error reported by customer, We suggest having performance monitoring of the Charger by having couple of Charging sessions.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0435871 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Yes
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.

afonso-sousa@siemens.com

.
